The '''Imperial Ore Facility''', also known as the '''Sienar Refinery''', was a industrial factory used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].

==Description==
The facility was constructed by the [[Imperial Engineering Corps/Legends|Imperial Engineering Corps]] and was one of two vital structures on that planet. Its counterpart was a [[Raxus Prime Imperial Shipyard|construction yard]] in orbit around the planet which was used to produce the Empire's feared [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The ore facility itself was a ground based facility that was situated amid the junkyard planet of Raxus Prime and was used to collect and transport huge amounts of processed ore to the factory in orbit.

The ground based structure made use of hundreds of smelting plants which in turn diverted processed ore to a massive gravity cannon to launch the material into orbit whereupon it was collected by the massive orbital construction facility that used it to build starships.

It was one of the most important Imperial military projects at the time and was protected by an entire legion of elite troops.

==History==
[[File:SizeMattersNot-TFU.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Galen Marek crashes a Star Destroyer into the ore facility.]]
After the death of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kazdan Paratus]], the planets [[Scrap Guardian|legion]] [[Scrap Scavenger|of]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Junk behemoth|soldiers]] collapsed into a lifeless pile of junk without [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to animate them. This allowed the Empire to establish a presence on the world and use its immense resources for the construction of its war machine.

[[Galen Marek]] was sent to Raxus Prime once again in order to sabotage the ore facilities gravity cannon in order to send the reprocessed ore at the construction facility in orbit thus destroying it.<ref name="Force" /> During his [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|mission,]] he encountered a [[Unidentified Shadow Guard (Raxus Prime)|member]] of the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]] who was protecting the factory but threw the guardsmen into the molten ore as it was sent into space.<ref name="ForceWii">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' Wii, PS2, and PSP versions</ref>

The ore destroyed the orbital factory and sent a Star Destroyer crashing into the ore facility thus damaging and possibly destroying it.
